sources.source_crs: EPSG:3857; query geometry returned in EPSG:4326
sources.source_date: Layer metadata dataLastEditDate is recorded in the retained metadata snapshot; feature has no per-feature edit date
sources.method: Closed 20-vertex GIS ring queried directly by FID. Converted lon/lat using repository approximate campus formula (origin 40.4274, -86.9137; X=(lon+86.9137)*111412.84*cos(40.4274deg), Y=(lat-40.4274)*111040).
sources.uncertainty: Source geometry and repository degrees-to-metres conversion are not a survey. ArcGIS Shape__Area and Shape__Length are not treated as metric dimensions because they conflict with measurements from the returned ring.

sources.source_date: Page copyright 2026; reports house built 1963, addition 1968, major renovations during the 1990s and updates through summer 2026
sources.uncertainty: Supports identity and chronology only, not geometry or measured vertical dimensions.

sources.source_date: Filename labels image Current2023; exact capture date is not independently confirmed
sources.method: Visual comparison of current chapter-home image for visible levels, wall material, roofline, window rhythm, entrance canopy, and terrace only.
sources.uncertainty: Perspective, vegetation, and image crop prevent reliable dimension measurements; unphotographed elevations and exact details remain unverified.

sources.provider: Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana Statewide 3DEP Lidar Dates MapServer
sources.source_crs: Indiana West State Plane, US survey feet for raster tile; point query EPSG:4326
sources.method: DSM cells intersecting converted FID 777 polygon; 5-ft cell size; median DSM elevation 653.94 ft over 316 selected cells.
sources.uncertainty: DSM includes ground and possible vegetation/roof edge contamination; vertical datum is unverified. A defensible building height cannot be derived without decoded and aligned DTM or surveyed elevations.

sources.provider: IndianaMap / Indiana Geographic Information Office, Indiana LiDAR-derived Building Footprints FeatureServer
sources.source_crs: EPSG:4326 query output; native FeatureServer layer CRS recorded in metadata snapshot
sources.source_date: LiDAR year 2018; dataset described as 2016-2020 Indiana building footprints
sources.method: Point query at Purdue FID777 location. Converted both rings with repository approximate campus transform; compared planar polygon areas, centroid separation, intersection-over-union, symmetric difference, and boundary Hausdorff distance.
sources.derived_comparison: Purdue GIS area 719.336 m2; Indiana LiDAR area 758.909 m2; centroid separation 1.422 m; IoU 0.8561; symmetric difference 114.606 m2; Hausdorff boundary distance 3.307 m.
sources.uncertainty: LiDAR-derived feature is independent, but retains acquisition, classification, and outline generalization error; difference shows neither polygon is a surveyed structural wall line.

gis_fields_conflicting_with_visual_evide.notes: Vertical field units, meaning, and datum are undocumented. They are not used as measured height or story count.
